label: adr-0026-baseline
note: Hand-rolled fan-out baseline for ADR 0026: one publisher turn staging one intent per subscriber

backend.name: postgres
backend.version: PostgreSQL 18.6 (Debian 18.6-1.pgdg12+2) on x86_64-pc-linux-gnu, compiled by gcc (Debian 12.2.0-14+deb12u1) 12.2.0, 64-bit

machine.topology: one machine; the benchmark client, actor runtime, and Postgres container share its CPUs; database over loopback TCP

scenarios.name: subscriptions
scenarios.description: Baseline for cross-actor subscriptions: a publisher turn that fans out by staging one intent per subscriber, at 1, 16, 256, and 1,024 subscribers.
